question.text: Under Section 5 of PMLA, who has the authority to order provisional attachment of property involved in money laundering?

answer.text: Any police officer of Inspector rank or above
The Director or any officer not below the rank of Deputy Director authorised by the Director
The Adjudicating Authority appointed under Section 6
Any officer of SEBI not below the rank of General Manager

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 5 of PMLA, the Director or any officer not below the rank of Deputy Director authorised by the Director may order provisional attachment of property. The order must be based on a reason to believe, recorded in writing, that proceeds of crime are likely to be concealed, transferred, or dealt with in a manner that may frustrate confiscation. The Trap: The other options describe authorities that are not specified for ordering provisional attachment under Section 5 in the pages checked, so they should not be picked on this question. Note: Page 29 of the NISM Series XXIV workbook supports that the Director or an authorised officer not below the rank of Deputy Director may order provisional attachment under Section 5; page 21 supports the related definitions of Director/Deputy Director and attachment.
